title: Latent Merger: Latent-Space Composition of Hypernetwork-Generated LoRAs
abstract: arXiv:2611.33048v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent work proposes hypernetworks that convert a document into a low-rank parameter update (LoRA) in a single forward pass, enabling fast injection of new knowledge into a frozen LLM. However, storing separate LoRA adapters for each document can be unsustainable in streaming settings. In this paper, we study the problem of composing hypernetwork-generated LoRAs using two representative systems, Doc-to-LoRA and SHINE. We show that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs have a geometry sharply different from directly fine-tuned LoRAs. They exhibit greater spectral concentration and stronger cross-document alignment than next-token prediction and QA fine-tuned adapters, which are diffuse and nearly orthogonal across documents. Guided by this observation, we propose latent-space LoRA merging. We compose the intermediate hypernetwork latents and then decode the merged latent through the frozen LoRA-generation head. translated_title: 潜在合并器：超网络生成LoRA的潜空间组合
translated_abstract: 近期研究提出了超网络方法，能够在单次前向传播中将文档转换为低秩参数更新，从而实现向冻结的大语言模型快速注入新知识。然而，在流式场景下为每个文档存储独立的LoRA适配器可能难以持续。本文以两个代表性系统Doc-to-LoRA和SHINE为例，研究组合超网络生成的LoRA这一问题。我们证明超网络生成的LoRA具有与直接微调的LoRA截然不同的几何特性：与基于下一个词预测和问答微调的适配器（其分布弥散且在不同文档间近乎正交）相比，超网络生成的LoRA表现出更强的谱集中性和更强的跨文档对齐性。基于这一观察，我们提出了潜空间LoRA合并方法：先组合超网络的中间潜变量，再通过冻结的LoRA生成头对合并后的潜变量进行解码。我们证明潜空间合并方法……
tldr: 该论文发现超网络生成的LoRA在几何特性上与直接微调的LoRA截然不同（谱更集中、跨文档对齐更强），据此提出在潜空间中直接组合中间潜变量再解码的LoRA合并方法，以解决流式场景下逐文档存储LoRA不可持续的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs exhibit a geometry sharply different from fine-tuned LoRAs (greater spectral concentration and stronger cross-document alignment), and accordingly proposes latent-space merging—composing intermediate hypernetwork latents and decoding them through the frozen generation head—to address the unsustainable cost of storing per-document LoRAs in streaming settings.
